appearance_facts.fact: A single dark red line connects yearly points from 2012 through 2023.
The 2012 point is the lowest visible point on the line, below the 800 gridline.
The 2023 point is the highest visible point on the line, above the 3200 gridline.
The line rises overall, with small local dips around 2015 and 2019–2020.
The title text is larger and bolder than the subtitle and axis labels.
